changes.summary: Replaced the hidden Foley prompt default with required prompt and video slots and an exact WAV output contract.
Made the adapter consume the controller-authenticated slot manifest before model loading.
Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.
changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.

changes.summary: Replaced the metadata-only binding with pinned Foley source, Transformers fork, Audiotools commit, and isolated video input.
Selected the XXL checkpoint, added exact SigLIP2 and CLAP artifacts, patched all model loads local-only, disabled fallback downloads, and verified WAV output.
Split the pinned Transformers archive into verified transport-bounded chunks and verify the reassembled archive before extraction.
Corrected the model and native runtime authorities from Apache-2.0 to the territorial Tencent Hunyuan Community License.
Marked the metadata-only candidate as requiring a native HunyuanVideo-Foley adapter that explicitly selects the XXL checkpoint before acceptance.
Initial reviewed catalog release of HunyuanVideo Foley XXL diffusers single Spark.
Recovered the first public legacy revision from before semantic release tracking.
